test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A man took a loan from a bank at the rate of 14% per annum simple interest. After 5 years he had to pay Rs. 7,000 as interest. Find the principal amount of the loan.
solution:
**Given:**

Rate of interest (R) = 14% per annum.

Time (T) = 5 years.

Simple Interest (SI) = Rs. 7,000.

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (Principal (P) × Rate (R) × Time (T)) / 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ 7,000 = (P × 14 × 5) / 100

⇒ 7,000 = (70P) / 100

⇒ 7,000 = 0.7P

⇒ P = 7,000 / 0.7

⇒ P = 10,000

**The principal amount of the loan is Rs. 10,000.**
